비타민B 츄어블Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6

Made by (주)알피바이오 · Once a day · 2 capsules

This product combines 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6 as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 capsules): 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)알피바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day2 capsules per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없으며 노란색의 내용물을 함유한 주황색의 타원형 츄어블 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage - 직사광선과 고온다습한 곳을 피하여 습기가 적고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오. - 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
